channel.title: Meeting Notes Updates
channel.description: Signed application updates for Meeting Notes.

item.description:
## What’s new
- Start a new recording immediately while the previous meeting finalizes safely in the background. - Interrupted captures remain visible after relaunch and can be retried or deleted per meeting. - Stopping no longer waits for a slow live-preview transcription prediction. - Meeting menus now include separate actions to open the summary and transcript. - Selected Tana Supertags are shown first, with both selected and unselected groups kept alphabetical.
## Reliability
- Finalizing an earlier meeting no longer replaces or disrupts a newer active recording. - Recovery targets the meeting you selected and no longer treats silent audio as recoverable speech.
